title: Integrate llm req execution and output
objective: Resolve configured request directories, construct parameters, call completeRequest, and print dynamic responses using existing output and exit semantics. Contract sections: requests/README.md#additional-input-files; requests/README.md#library-and-cli-boundaries; requests/README.md#request-name-and-filesystem-safety. Explicit human operator confirmation is required before modifying requests/README.md.

branch.name: llm-request-lookup
branch.rationale: The record captures bounded planning without creating or switching a branch.

request.text: Prepare small, testable work items for dynamic request lookup: document requests/README.md; support request asset discovery; schema-aware CLI parameters including dot/index paths and --parameters JSON; $${variableName}$$ substitution; completeRequest({ requestName, parameters, files, ... }); llm req CLI integration; raw/full output; summarize compatibility; provider-free validation.

scope.name: configured-lookup
scope.description: llm req resolves configured root and request name before loading and supports summarize-compatible additional input files.

scope.name: shared-completion
scope.description: Valid input constructs parameters and calls completeRequest({ requestName, parameters, files, ... }) once.

scope.name: output-contract
scope.description: Raw/full success and JSON failure output follow existing writers and exit codes.

scope.name: cli-regression
scope.reason: Integration must not regress current modes.

scope.name: authoritative-contract
scope.description: Implement only the authoritative contract sections [Additional input files](#additional-input-files), [Library and CLI boundaries](#library-and-cli-boundaries), [Request-name and filesystem safety](#request-name-and-filesystem-safety). Do not modify requests/README.md without explicit human operator confirmation.
scope.reason: The request README is the source of truth for this implementation batch.

nonGoals.name: implementation
nonGoals.description: Do not implement behavior outside this work item.

nonGoals.name: provider-and-release
nonGoals.description: Do not make authenticated calls, publish, deploy, or claim production readiness.

nonGoals.name: unrelated-refactor
nonGoals.description: Do not redesign unrelated commands, providers, schemas, or persistence.
nonGoals.reason: Scope is limited to dynamic request lookup.

items.name: configured-lookup
items.description: llm req resolves configured root and request name before loading and supports summarize-compatible --path/--content additional files.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Valid roots work and missing/unsafe names fail before provider use.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Raw is only successful raw output; full is the envelope; errors are JSON stderr with nonzero exit.
